# Jakarta One Running Series

> Jakarta One Running Series is a five-stage 5.00 km running series across Jakarta's five administrative cities, from South Jakarta on 1 November 2026 to the Central Jakarta championship on 6 June 2027. Official site: https://jakartaonerunningseries.com

## Race calendar (all stages: Sunday, 5.00 km, race start 06.30 WIB)

- South Jakarta: Sunday, 1 November 2026. Start and finish at SCBD, Jakarta Selatan.
- North Jakarta: Sunday, 17 January 2027. Start and finish at Ancol, Jl. Lodan Raya, Pademangan, Jakarta Utara.
- West Jakarta: Sunday, 21 March 2027. Start and finish at Puri, Jl. Puri Agung, Puri Indah, Jakarta Barat.
- East Jakarta: Sunday, 25 April 2027. Start and finish at the Velodrome, Jl. Pemuda, Rawamangun, Jakarta Timur.
- Central Jakarta (grand finale): Sunday, 6 June 2027. Start and finish at Lapangan Banteng, Jl. Lapangan Banteng Utara, Sawah Besar, Jakarta Pusat.

## Key facts

- Distance: 5.00 km per stage.
- Registration price: Rp 195,000 per stage.
- Capacity: 10,000 runners per stage.
- Race village: 04.30-11.00. Race start: 06.30. Race finish: 08.00. Cut-off time: 90 minutes.
- Race pack collection: Hotel Borobudur, Jl. Lapangan Banteng Selatan, Sawah Besar, Jakarta Pusat.
- Registration and tickets: https://id.bookmyshow.com/en/collections/onerunningseries
